# About Us

eMERG, the Engineering Manufacturer Entrepreneurs Resource Group, is the brainchild of a group of enterprising business women. eMERG was founded in an era when women engineers in India were still foraying in small numbers – into entrepreneurship. With hardly any eco system and support available, an exclusive professional networking space for women in engineering manufacturing was unheard of. Yet, the need to associate with others in the space, share the challenges, experiences and hard earned wisdom – led Seven enterprising women engineers to found eMERG in 2006, in Bangalore, India.

Over the years, eMERG has grown exponentially, and now is an association for women in technology, business, profession & services. As a Not for Profit organization, eMERG works to provide women a platform to showcase and develop their business and talents. eMERG regularly conducts training programs for the members, which provides them opportunities to learn about the current policies, funding facilities as well as training potentials available from the government and the non-government sectors. eMERG organizes trade delegations nationally as well as internationally which provides excellent exposure opportunities.

![](https://emergindia.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/emergindia.jpg)

![](https://emergindia.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/emergwomen.webp)

![](https://emergindia.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/i43.png)

# Our Vision

> **_“To build an association and platform for women entrepreneurs  in technology, business and services to support in their growth by providing a platform to nurture opportunities for network, growth and scaling both nationally and internationally.”_**

## A message from Uma Reddy, Founder and past President

![](https://emergindia.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Untitled-design-24.png)

A decade of walking with entrepreneurial women!

An interesting journey – from visioning an association at the growth level for women in technology, in 2006 to having a vibrant group of women in technology, business and services in 2016. It is this dream that the 7 founding members envisioned to support the growth of women in technology, business, profession and services. There was a felt need for a platform to support at the growth level of women owned enterprises, especially in the area of technology. So, along with a team of like minded members, eMERG has provided an opportunity for entrepreneurial women, to network, both national and international, for business growth.

Women entrepreneurs are the new engines of growth to an economy and women owned businesses form an integral component of MSMEs. eMERG has been carrying out various activities to achieve its objective and contribute to the growth of women owned enterprises and their participation & contribution to national economy. Mentoring, Training, Policy advocacy and certification are the many activities of eMERG, in its journey, to achieve its objectives.The flagship annual event of eMERG is an international business Convention – Forging Links Leveraging Networks, where more and more women participate to learn, grow, network and be part of mainstream business.The focus of eMERG for the future is a B-B portal, a business incubator and a training centre in basic engineering skills source of innovation, job creation and As a founder President, have been very happy with the growth path of eMERG supporting women entrepreneurs, women managers & women professionals.Wishing all women entrepreneurs, women Managers and women professionals, exponential growth.Best RegardsUma Reddy Founder President, eMERG

## A message from Ms Rajalakshmi R, Past President

![](https://emergindia.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Untitled-design-25.png)

It was a pleasure being President of eMERG for ten years ! A journey of learning, sharing , mentoring , and working with aspiring and experienced women entrepreneurs.

We have seen great times with our members, and now during these trying times, we are doing our best to keep our members connected and engaged

I wish to convey my congratulations to the the present committee and office bearers for the good job they have been doing. I also wish them great luck and my support for future growth of eMERG!

Best Regards

**Ms Rajalakshmi R** Past President, eMERG

## A message from Ms Radhika Setty, President eMERG, Bangalore

![](https://emergindia.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/IMG_20240927_114218-203x300.jpg)

## **Namaskara,**

## **Greetings!**

I’m pleased to announce that following our Annual General Body Meeting on July 18, 2024, we have welcomed new leaders to our team: a President, Secretary, and Joint Secretary, who will join our existing office bearers.

Since its inception in 2006, eMERG – Engineering Manufacturer Entrepreneurs Resource Group – has been dedicated to advancing women in technology, business, and services. As a not-for-profit association, our mission is to contribute to societal development and drive economic growth through our robust network and support initiatives.

Our key strengths lie in fostering problem-solving and growth for MSMEs and professionals, with a particular emphasis on women. We proudly operate a Centre of Excellence that offers a range of training programs designed to upskill and reskill women entrepreneurs. Looking ahead, we are excited to introduce a series of Management Development Programs (MDPs) and Executive Development Programs (EDPs) to help our members stay aligned with the latest market trends.

Our mentoring program continues to receive positive feedback. We provide hands-on guidance through an experienced panel of mentors who support our members’ growth journeys. Additionally, our e-commerce portal, AMULYA DIGIMART, is a unique platform that enables members to promote their products and services online and access a broader market.

Thank you all for your continued support. We look forward to an impactful and successful journey together in the future.

Best Regards,

**Ms Radhika Setty,** President

## Meet the Team

## For our office bearers eMERG is not a profession but a passion that's beyond their professional careers

![](https://emergindia.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Untitled-design-26.png)

### Dr. Sumitha Nayak, Immediate Past President

A pediatrician by profession, Dr. Sumitha also the proprietor of IdeaTech Associates that deals with excellence in the written world, providing exposure and opportunities across the globe

### Ms Pratibha Nakil, Vice President

Founder and CEO of Asteria Softech. Been In business for last 21 years. Due to her experience she understands the Challenges faced by Women Entrepreneurs and therefore helps them in various aspects of business.

![](https://emergindia.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Untitled-design-28.png)

![](https://emergindia.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Untitled-design-30.png)

### Dr Trupti Anandnatha K, Treasurer

Founder Director Ojas Ayurveda and Nutrition clinic Bangalore
Nutrition Advisor Indian Airforce Boys Sports squadron Bangalore
Faculty at Centre for integrative health and wellness ( CIHW)

### Ms Nityashree, Honorary Secretary

Nityashree from Riches Laboratories we are into manufacturing of Herbal Cosmetics such as Handcrafted Soaps, Shampoos, Body Lotion, Body Wash, Body Butter and Lip under the brand name Nesar with a tag line Embracing Tradition Naturally.

![](https://emergindia.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Untitled-design-41.png)

![](https://emergindia.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Untitled-design-31.png)

### Dr Debolina Gupts, Joint Secretary

Dr. Debolina Gupta, a distinguished Assistant Professor at School of Management, CMR University, embodies the core principles of entrepreneurship through her work in Management education and research. Known for her innovative teaching methods and dedication to shaping future leaders, she seamlessly integrates entrepreneurial thinking into her curriculum, inspiring students to embrace creativity, take calculated risks, and develop strategic solutions through her teaching practices. She is a soft skills trainer and implements HR practices contributing significantly to the holistic development of students and aspiring professionals.

eMERG is an association of women in technology, business, profession and service and as such represents women in these various sectors. Acting as a platform that brings together women from diverse workplaces, e MERG provides the dynamism and visibility which is essential in today’s competitive business arena.

Being a member of eMERG will ensure that you are part of an extremely vibrant and dynamic group of women. You will learn new skills and obtain knowledge that will be beneficial to your profession, career or business. You will get a chance to attend exclusive international business meets and trade fairs. eMERG participates in several governmental and public sector programs. Above all, eMERG gives you an excellent opportunity to showcase and grow your business or profession.

So what are you waiting for? Join eMERG today!!!
